proposed.explanation: Sustainability is explicitly integrated as part of contemporary critical regionalism. Digital fabrication can enhance regional traditions without erasing them. Expansion and refinement, not abandonment of principles. Contemporary critical regionalism has expanded beyond Frampton's original framework to encompass digital fabrication rooted in regional craft traditions, sustainable material strategies responsive to local ecology...The framework resists both nostalgic regionalism...and...parochialism that refuses necessary global engagement.' This shows evolution while maintaining foundational commitments.
